# Context/cache sources

- Pi: earendil-works/pi, commit 28dcce2ba45ce4a9efeb0f5b686f0be830fd89b9, MIT (LICENSE in this directory). cloud_agent.request_cost ports the content/argument counting approach from packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/compaction.ts estimateTokens, retaining AIPraat's existing CJK estimator. compact_phase follows user-start transaction cut points. session_context and skill_registry use the append-only context and local skill catalog patterns from packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts and packages/coding-agent/src/core/skills.ts; they are Python adapters rather than a copied TypeScript runtime.
- Pydantic AI 2.52.0: existing dependency; public message_history, ModelRequest/ModelResponse, ModelMessagesTypeAdapter, RequestUsage.extract and Hooks supply protocol execution, schemas, message pairing and provider usage normalization. No new harness/SDK upgrade or duplicate tool loop.
- OnlyTerp/prompt-cache-skills commit 5b58ae26bd446bfb2eee97e8dad076ffb46a6715: check_cache.py is copied unchanged under MIT to ../prompt-cache-skills. The development skill adapts its final-wire and three-turn verification workflow under the MIT option. Inclusive input normalization and missing-field semantics are supplied by this project's SDK adapter instead of the upstream probe's generic hit_rate.
- Hermes commit 79af3f6cea8067284a7ea5725078578b3f790adb agent/prompt_cache_boundary.py was inspected. Its Anthropic process-global scaffold registry is not needed by the current implicit Chat Completions path and was not copied.

Necessary project code: SQLite migration, session/client ownership, source-file binding and guard/budget integration. These require AIPraat's existing data model and cannot be supplied by upstream TypeScript or Cline-specific patches. Runtime skill bodies migrate existing AIPraat rules without new model classification or read-skill calls. Explicit cache parameters remain disabled by default; no unsupported cache fields are sent to compatible gateways.
